children: UK publishing software provider's H1 26 revenue declined slightly yr/yr due to FX and legacy work
Adjusted EPS and EBITDA for H1 26 fell compared to prior year
Company acquired FirstAida Limited post period-end, expanding AI capabilities in legal sector
Ingenta says it is on track to meet FY26 company-compiled adjusted EBITDA expectations of £1.4m
Company expects FirstAida acquisition to help drive future growth
Ingenta prioritising investment in sales team to enhance future performance
CURRENCY AND LEGACY WORK - Co said revenue decline was mainly due to FX movements and wind-down of legacy work
COMMERCIAL REVENUE GROWTH - Commercial revenue rose 5% driven by managed services from existing customers
CONTENT REVENUE DECLINE - Content revenue fell 7% due to lower implementation and consultancy activity
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Ingenta PLC is GBp130.00, about 58.5% above its September 22 closing price of GBp82.00
